items.expected: Keep the full 96-atom C87H7Y2 identity, neutral charge and radical state explicit. For tensor or vibrational comparisons, document coordinate frames, atom mapping, tensor conventions and normalization. If inferring derivatives or thermal relevance, validate the chosen numerical representation and its uncertainty rather than confusing axis rotations with physical response.
Quantify spin response and relevant molecular-motion information for both isomers under clearly stated conditions, linked to raw tensor/structure/vibration or equivalent valid evidence.

items.statement: Evidence that distinguishes the claimed explanation
items.expected: Support an explanation of the isomer difference with a defensible mapping between motion and spin response. Mode classes, finite-difference order and metric are not prescribed; numerical artifacts and frame changes must be distinguished from physical modulation.

Assess reliability of the motion/state description, sensitivity of inferred response and limitations of any connection to temperature-dependent relaxation. A demonstrated absence of a resolvable difference is valid.
